question: Who is the author of the book ’The Householder’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitabha Bagchi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amitabha Bagchi** is the author of the book *"The Householder."* The novel explores themes of family, societal expectations, and moral dilemmas.
 
• **The Householder** is a contemporary Indian novel that provides insight into the struggles and complexities of middle-class Indian life.
 
• Amitabha Bagchi is known for his vivid storytelling and ability to portray realistic characters, often with a focus on urban and societal settings.
 
• This book stands out for its deep exploration of human relationships and the challenges of balancing personal and societal responsibilities.
 
• Bagchi has authored several critically acclaimed novels, including **"Above Average"** and **"Half the Night is Gone,"** which won the DSC Prize for South Asian Literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ruskin Bond:**

 
 
• Ruskin Bond is a celebrated Indian author known for his works based in the hills of India, particularly Mussoorie.
 
• His notable works include *"The Room on the Roof"* and *"The Blue Umbrella."* These works often highlight themes of nature, childhood, and human connections.
 
• Bond's writing style is simple yet evocative, appealing to readers of all ages.
 
 
 
• **Satyajit Ray:**
 
 
• Satyajit Ray was a legendary filmmaker, writer, and artist from India, renowned for his contribution to cinema and literature.
 
• He is best known for creating the **Feluda series**, a collection of detective stories, and **"The Adventures of Professor Shonku."**
 
• Ray's works often blend elements of mystery, science fiction, and cultural richness.
 
 
 
• **Arun Joshi:**
 
 
• Arun Joshi was an Indian author known for his introspective novels that delve into existential themes.
 
• His notable works include *"The Foreigner"* and *"The Apprentice."*
 
• Joshi's writing often reflects the psychological struggles of individuals in urban settings.
 
 
 
• **Amitabha Bagchi:**
 
 
• Amitabha Bagchi's novels focus on contemporary issues faced by individuals in urban and middle-class settings.
 
• His work, *"Half the Night is Gone,"* won the **DSC Prize for South Asian Literature.**
 
• Bagchi is celebrated for his ability to capture the nuances of human relationships and societal expectations.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Amitabha Bagchi's Writing Style:**

 
 
• Bagchi's writing is known for its depth, emotional resonance, and realistic portrayal of characters.
 
• His books often explore themes such as morality, societal pressures, and interpersonal relationships.
 
• He is particularly skilled at depicting the struggles of the Indian middle-class, making his works relatable and impactful.
 
 
 
• **Contemporary Indian Literature:**
 
 
• Authors like Amitabha Bagchi contribute significantly to the genre by highlighting modern societal issues and personal dilemmas.
 
• Such novels provide a window into the evolving cultural and social landscape of India.
 
• Contemporary literature often combines traditional values with modern challenges, offering a unique perspective to readers.
